QuestInfo.name: The Reunion
QuestInfo.0: #p1012100# is crying, just like when she was a child. She's gone through these hundreds of years all by herself...

0.0: When I got back to Victoria Island, I made sure the refugees were safe... Then I went back to the village, but the path was sealed...\r\n#L0##bWe had to keep the curse from spreading. I'm sorry I never had a chance to warn you...#l\n#k
0.1: I came back so many times, I lost count...and the seal was always there, every time... I couldn't get through! No matter how many arrows I fired... No matter how many times I threw myself against it... I didn't know...\r\n#L0##bI'm sorry. I wish I could tell you things were going to be okay...#l\n#k
0.2: Y-your Highness... I thought! I thought I'd never get to see you...again...

1.0: I'm okay. Your Highness... You haven't changed at all since I last saw you.\r\n#L0##bAnd you grew up... Are you older than me now?#l\n#k
1.1: You're right! Oh, how strange... I'm older than the ruler of the Elves.\r\n#L0##bYou'll have to excuse me. It's going to take me some time to get used to... Athena Pierce, all grown up.#l\n#k
1.2: All that matters is that we're both alive. I never thought I could be this happy again...

yes.0: But how did you find me? Was the seal lifted from the village? I want to hear everything!
